nodes.description: Evaluates a math expression over x in [0,1] to produce a float curve closure. Variable: x. Constants: pi, e, tau. Operators: + - * / ^ (power). Trig: sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2(y,x) sinh cosh tanh. Rounding: floor ceil round sign abs fract. Exp: exp log log2 log10 sqrt pow(x,n). Range: min max clamp(x,lo,hi) step(edge,x) mod(x,y). Interpolation: lerp(a,b,t) inverselerp(a,b,x) remap(x,inLo,inHi,outLo,outHi). Easing: smoothstep(e0,e1,x) smootherstep(e0,e1,x) ease_in(x) ease_out(x) ease_in_out(x). Organic: smin(a,b,k) pingpong(x,len). Use function_curve for math formulas, float_curve for hand-tuned control points.

inputs.name: major_radius
inputs.description: Distance from the origin to the centre of the tube. The torus spans major_radius + minor_radius on the X and Z axes.

inputs.name: minor_radius
inputs.description: Radius of the tube. Must be smaller than major_radius for the surface to stay embedded; equal or larger values self-intersect.

inputs.name: major_segments
inputs.description: Face divisions the long way around, about the Y axis. Default 24.

inputs.name: minor_segments
inputs.description: Face divisions around the tube. Default 12.

inputs.name: triangulate
inputs.description: Split each quad into two triangles along a diagonal. Needed by the quad-layout pipeline, which consumes triangle meshes. Default false.

outputs.name: mesh
outputs.description: Torus centred at the origin, tube encircling the Y axis. Closed, genus 1, so V - E + F = 0.

nodes.description: Generates a torus: a closed genus-1 surface with a fully regular face grid, no poles and no boundary, optionally triangulated.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.description: Input/output geometry bundle. Vertex positions and curve control points are transformed; bezier handle slots are scaled and rotated in place.

inputs.name: translation
inputs.description: World-space offset added after scale+rotate. translation=<X,Y,Z> shifts every vertex by those units.

inputs.name: rotation
inputs.description: Euler XYZ in RADIANS (not degrees). Applied after scale, before translate. <0,0,0> = identity.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Per-axis multiplier applied first. scale=<X,Y,Z> stretches extent by those factors componentwise: output extent = input extent × scale. Pass 1.0 to leave an axis untouched, not 0.5. To map a unit cube (extent 1) onto a reference with extent <Ex,Ey,Ez>, use scale=<Ex,Ey,Ez>.

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.description: Input/output geometry bundle. Vertex positions and curve control points are transformed; bezier handle slots are scaled and rotated in place.

nodes.description: Applies translation, rotation, and scale to mesh vertices and curve geometry using standard SRT order.

inputs.name: segments
inputs.description: Longitudinal divisions (meridians). Higher = smoother around the equator. Default 32.

inputs.name: rings
inputs.description: Latitudinal bands between the two poles. Higher = smoother pole-to-pole. Default 16.

outputs.name: mesh
outputs.description: Quad-banded sphere with triangle-fan poles, centered at origin.

nodes.description: Generates a latitude/longitude sphere with quad bands and triangle-fan poles, controlled by radius, segments (longitude), and rings (latitude).
